method.primary_source: deposited RNA polymer sequence in the PDBe updated mmCIF (_pdbx_poly_seq_scheme.mon_id at label_asym_id + label_seq_id)
consistency_checks: residue_name of the validated family mapping
method.nonstandard_definition: any other reliably identified component of the RNA polymer; components are not classified (natural, synthetic, engineered, post-transcriptional)
method.consensus_positions: validated family mapping only (match state); insert, local-end and outside-mapped-region residues have no consensus position
method.cross_validation: PDBe modified_AA_or_NA (an absent PDBe record is not evidence of a standard nucleotide)
method.enrichment: CCD parent (mon_nstd_parent_comp_id, wwPDB CCD); NAKB/BGSU standard_base and change locations (chemistry reference only)

provenance.mmcif_source: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pdbe/entry-files/download/<pdb>_updated.cif (PDBe updated mmCIF, pipeline cache; per-instance retrieval in instances[].mmcif_source)

pdbe_modified_AA_or_NA.note: cross-validation only; a missing PDBe record is not evidence of a standard nucleotide

nakb.note: chemistry reference only (parent nucleotide, change locations); not evidence of occurrence in a chain
